ui.location.title: Find us

cards.title: New arrivals every week
cards.body: Our inventory changes constantly: appliances, accessories, toys, home goods, tools, seasonal products, and more. You may find new, open-box, or customer-returned items from surplus inventory, refused deliveries, store closures, and end-of-season clearances.

cards.title: A testing area in store
cards.body: Want to check an item before buying? Open the box, inspect the contents, and test the product when possible. We encourage you to make sure the main parts and accessories are included before checkout.

cards.title: A real treasure hunt
cards.body: Everything is first come, first served. Products are unique, quantities are limited, and the best finds go quickly. Every visit brings something different.

cards.title: Fresh stock every Saturday
cards.body: New weekly inventory goes on the shelves every Saturday. This is when the most interesting, rare, or valuable items arrive, so prices are at their highest.

cards.title: Prices drop all week
cards.body: Prices gradually decrease based on what remains. The usual range is $25 on Saturday down to as little as $1 on Friday, adjusted according to quantity, quality, and demand. Higher-priced items are different: their price is generally fixed at about 50% off the regular in-store price.

cards.title: Our return policy
cards.body: Please inspect and test your purchase before leaving. For items over $5, product defects or missing parts can be reported within 24 hours, until closing the following day. We offer an exchange or store credit, not cash refunds. Change-of-mind returns are not accepted; clothing and shoes are final sale.

cards.title: Why customers come back
items: Products from major brands and retailers
